verdict.rationale: Parsec documents multi-monitor streaming of up to 3 displays and virtual monitors, and says hosts can control which apps guests see and interact with, so it has its own monitor- and app-level viewing features. Nothing shows a user picking a specific monitor, window, or app to view, or switching between them mid-session. missing for 10: documented selection of a specific monitor/window/app to view, mid-session switching between displays, window-level capture, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can view a specific monitor, window, or app on a multi-display host and switch between them mid-session

citations.quote: The host can control exactly which apps connected guests are approved to see and interact with
